paragraphs.text: Every winter, road authorities in cold countries spread millions of tonnes of salt to keep roads free of ice. Salt lowers the temperature at which water freezes, so a thin layer of salty water on the road surface stays liquid at a few degrees below zero. Below about minus ten degrees, however, ordinary rock salt works too slowly to be of much use.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The benefits for safety are clear. A study in the United States found that accidents on salted roads fell by up to 85 per cent in the four hours after treatment. But the salt does not disappear when the ice melts. It washes into rivers and lakes, and in some areas the water now contains so much salt that it harms freshwater fish.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Engineers are therefore trying to use less. Many authorities now spray roads with salty water before a storm arrives, which stops ice from bonding to the surface and needs about a quarter of the salt used on frozen roads. Trucks fitted with temperature sensors adjust the amount they spread as they drive.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Some cities have tested alternatives, such as a liquid made from beet juice mixed with salt, which sticks to the road and keeps working at lower temperatures. These mixtures are more expensive, and so far they are used mainly on bridges, where ice forms first.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Below about minus ten degrees, however, ordinary rock salt works too slowly to be of much use
items.prompt: Rock salt is less effective when the temperature is very low.

explanation.en: “works too slowly to be of much use” below minus ten is exactly “less effective when the temperature is very low” → TRUE.
explanation.kk: −10 градустан төмен «works too slowly to be of much use» — дәл осы «less effective when the temperature is very low» дегенді білдіреді → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «works too slowly to be of much use» при температуре ниже −10 — это и есть «less effective when the temperature is very low» → TRUE.

items.quote: fell by up to 85 per cent in the four hours after treatment
items.prompt: The US study measured accidents over a full day after salting.

explanation.en: “in the four hours after treatment” — the period was four hours, not a full day. The statement contradicts the figure → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «in the four hours after treatment» — кезең тәулік емес, төрт сағат. Тұжырым мәтіндегі санға қайшы → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «in the four hours after treatment» — период четыре часа, а не сутки. Утверждение противоречит цифре в тексте → FALSE.

items.quote: the water now contains so much salt that it harms freshwater fish
items.prompt: Salt in rivers has reduced the number of birds living near them.

explanation.en: The text mentions harm to fish (“harms freshwater fish”), nothing about birds. The fish are a distractor; you cannot conclude anything about birds from them → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Мәтінде тұздың балыққа зияны айтылады («harms freshwater fish»), құстар туралы бір сөз жоқ. Балық туралы дерек — алаңдатушы нұсқа, одан құстар туралы қорытынды шықпайды → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Текст говорит о вреде для рыб («harms freshwater fish»), о птицах — ни слова. Рыбы рядом в тексте — дистрактор, по ним нельзя делать вывод о птицах → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: needs about a quarter of the salt used on frozen roads
items.prompt: Spraying salty water before a storm uses less salt than treating roads that are already frozen.

explanation.en: “needs about a quarter of the salt used on frozen roads” — a quarter of the amount is less → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «needs about a quarter of the salt used on frozen roads» — мөлшердің төрттен бірі, яғни азырақ → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «needs about a quarter of the salt used on frozen roads» — четверть от количества — это меньше → TRUE.

items.prompt: Beet juice mixtures cost less than ordinary salt.

explanation.en: “These mixtures are more expensive” — they cost more, but the statement says “cost less” → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «These mixtures are more expensive» — қоспалар қымбатырақ, ал тұжырымда «cost less» делінген → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «These mixtures are more expensive» — смеси дороже, а в утверждении «cost less» → FALSE.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.
